digo: Chidzedza; Kongwe chetu; Dzedza (Pakia App. VI)
other_mijikenda: Duruma, Swahili: share the name dzedza; Swahili shares kongwe chetu (Pakia App. VI)

teaser.en: The 'female' dayflower: Digo pick it out from its male partner by its larger, deeper blue flowers.
teaser.sw: Mmea 'jike' wa jamii ya kongwe: Wadigo huutofautisha na mwenzi wake dume kwa maua yake makubwa zaidi ya buluu iliyokolea.
teaser.dg: *Chidzedza* ni mmea wa 'chichetu': Adigo anachitafwautisha na mlumewe kpwa maruwage makulu, ga samawati sana.

summary.en: *Chidzedza*, also called *kongwe chetu*, is a creeping dayflower with bright blue flowers. Digo count it as the female form because its flowers are larger and a deeper blue than the 'male' species.
summary.sw: *Chidzedza*, unaoitwa pia *kongwe chetu*, ni mmea wa jamii ya kongwe (dayflower) unaotambaa, wenye maua ya buluu angavu. Wadigo huuhesabu kuwa umbo la jike kwa sababu maua yake ni makubwa zaidi na ya buluu iliyokolea kuliko ya spishi 'dume'.
summary.dg: *Chidzedza*, ambacho piya chinaihwa *kongwe chetu*, ni mmea unaoambala photsi wenye maruwa ga samawati inayong'ala. Adigo anachiona kukala ni cha chichetu kpwa sababu maruwage ni makulu na ga samawati sana kuriko ga aina ya 'chilume'.

about.en: *Commelina bracteosa* is a trailing, somewhat succulent herb that roots at its joints. Its leaves have sheathing bases, and its flowers come out of folded, boat-shaped bracts. Each flower has three petals, usually two large blue ones and a smaller one, and lasts for a single morning. Pakia classes it with the grasses (*nyasi*) and notes that Digo identify it by its leaves.
about.sw: *Commelina bracteosa* ni mmea mdogo unaotambaa, wenye majimaji kiasi, ambao hutoa mizizi kwenye vifundo vyake. Majani yake yana vitako vinavyozunguka shina kama ala, na maua yake hutokea ndani ya vikonyo-jani (bracts) vilivyokunjwa kama mashua. Kila ua lina petali tatu, kwa kawaida mbili kubwa za buluu na moja ndogo zaidi, na hudumu asubuhi moja tu. Pakia anauweka pamoja na nyasi (*nyasi*) na anaeleza kwamba Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake.
about.dg: *Commelina bracteosa* ni mmea laini unaoambala photsi, wenye madzi chidide, na unamera mizi phatu mafundoge ganaphoguta tsi. Photsi ya chila kodza inazunguluka muhi dza mfuko, na maruwa ganatuluka ndani ya makodza madide ganayokundzwa, ga umbo dza dau. Chila ruwa rina makodza ga ruwa mahahu: mara nyinji mairi makulu ga samawati na rimwenga ridide, na rinavuguka ligundzu rimwenga tu. Pakia anachiika kahi ya *nyasi* na anaandika kukala Adigo anachimanya kpwa makodzage.

where.en: It grows in grassland, along paths, in field margins and damp places in tropical Africa.
where.sw: Huota katika nyika za nyasi, kando ya njia, pembezoni mwa mashamba na mahali penye unyevu katika maeneo ya tropiki ya Afrika.
where.dg: Chinamera phatu pha nyasi, kanda-kanda ya njira na ya minda, na phatu phasiphouma, kosi Afrika ya tsi za dzoho.

culture.en: *Kongwe chetu* means 'female *kongwe*'. Digo count this species as the female because it has large, deep blue flowers, while *kongwe lume* (*Commelina forskaolii*), the male, has smaller and less colourful ones. Pakia uses the pair to show how Digo male and female names follow visible differences.
culture.sw: *Kongwe chetu* maana yake ni '*kongwe* jike'. Wadigo huihesabu spishi hii kuwa jike kwa sababu ina maua makubwa ya buluu iliyokolea, ilhali *kongwe lume* (*Commelina forskaolii*), dume, ina maua madogo zaidi yasiyo na rangi nyingi. Pakia anatumia jozi hii kuonyesha jinsi majina ya Kidigo ya dume na jike yanavyofuata tofauti zinazoonekana.
culture.dg: *Kongwe chetu* rina mana ya '*kongwe* wa chichetu'. Adigo anaiona aina hino kukala ni ya chichetu kpwa sababu ina maruwa makulu ga samawati sana, ela *kongwe lume* (*Commelina forskaolii*), ambayo ni ya chilume, ina maruwa madide zaidi, ga rangi isiyong'ala sana. Pakia anahumira jozi hino kuonyesa vira madzina ga Chidigo ga chilume na ga chichetu ganavyolunga tafwauti zinazoonekana na matso.

names.en: Pakia records *chidzedza* and *kongwe chetu* for this species, and in his notes on names also gives *dzedza*. *Dzedza* is the name usually given to the common wandering Jew, *Commelina benghalensis*, so the name is shared within the genus. *Dzedza* is shared with Duruma and Swahili, and *kongwe chetu* with Swahili. The meaning of *dzedza* is not recorded.
names.sw: Pakia ameandika *chidzedza* na *kongwe chetu* kwa spishi hii, na katika maelezo yake kuhusu majina pia anatoa *dzedza*. *Dzedza* ni jina ambalo kwa kawaida hupewa mmea wa kawaida unaoitwa kwa Kiingereza *wandering Jew*, *Commelina benghalensis*, kwa hiyo jina hili linashirikiwa ndani ya jenasi. *Dzedza* linashirikiwa na Kiduruma na Kiswahili, na *kongwe chetu* na Kiswahili. Maana ya *dzedza* haijarekodiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *chidzedza* na *kongwe chetu* kpwa aina hino, na kpwenye maelezoge ga madzina piya anaandika *dzedza*. *Dzedza* ni dzina rinarohumirwa sana kpwa *Commelina benghalensis* (*wandering Jew*), kpwa hivyo dzina hiri rinahumirwa kpwa aina zaidi ya mwenga za jenasi hino. Chiduruma na Chiswahili piya vina dzina *dzedza*, na Chiswahili piya china *kongwe chetu*. Mana ya *dzedza* taiandikpwa.
